title: 馬克白 4-1 大釜幻影
style_suffix: black and white ink comic style, high contrast, heavy shadows, dark fantasy atmosphere
characters: Macbeth, a broad-shouldered warrior in dark plate armor, shoulder-length black hair, short black beard, a pale diagonal scar across his left cheek

panels.prompt: a firelit cave interior, a great iron cauldron boiling over green-tinged flames, steam coiling upward into shapes of screaming faces, three hunched crone silhouettes circling the cauldron, only outlines visible

dialogue.speaker: 女巫甲
dialogue.en: Thrice the brinded cat hath mewed.

dialogue.speaker: 女巫丙
dialogue.text: 怪鳥在鳴嘯：時候到了，時候到了。

panels.prompt: extreme close-up of a boiling cauldron surface, newt eyes and frog toes and bat fur and a forked snake tongue sinking into the bubbling black brew, sparks rising

dialogue.speaker: 眾巫（合）
dialogue.text: 不憚辛勞不憚煩，釜中沸沫已成瀾。
dialogue.en: Double, double toil and trouble; fire burn, and cauldron bubble.

quote.text: 不憚辛勞不憚煩，釜中沸沫已成瀾

panels.prompt: close-up of a hag witch with a torn grinning mouth splitting her shadowed face, holding up her crooked thumb before the cauldron firelight, eyes gleaming

dialogue.speaker: 女巫乙
dialogue.text: 拇指怦怦動，必有惡人來。
dialogue.en: By the pricking of my thumbs, something wicked this way comes.

panels.prompt: Macbeth, a broad-shouldered warrior in dark plate armor, shoulder-length black hair, short black beard, a pale diagonal scar across his left cheek, stepping out of cave darkness into firelight, wind whipping a black cloak around him

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 你們這些幽冥的妖婆，在幹什麼？憑你們的法術，我命令你們——回答我！
dialogue.en: How now, you secret, black, and midnight hags! What is't you do? I conjure you, answer me.

panels.prompt: thunder inside the cave, the cauldron erupting a pillar of black smoke, an armored helmeted head rising from it wreathed in sparks and lightning, a cloaked warrior shielding his eyes in the foreground

dialogue.speaker: 第一幽靈
dialogue.text: 馬克白！馬克白！留心麥克德夫——留心費輔爵士！
dialogue.en: Macbeth! Macbeth! Macbeth! Beware Macduff; beware the Thane of Fife.

panels.prompt: close-up of a scarred warrior's face lit from below by green cauldron fire, eyes narrowed in grim recognition

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 不管你是什麼精靈——你一語道破了我的憂慮。
dialogue.en: Whate'er thou art, for thy good caution, thanks; thou hast harped my fear aright.

panels.prompt: a blood-covered newborn child apparition floating in cauldron smoke, glowing faintly against total darkness, one tiny hand outstretched

dialogue.speaker: 第二幽靈
dialogue.text: 你要殘忍、勇敢、堅決。沒有一個婦人所生的人，可以傷害馬克白。
dialogue.en: Be bloody, bold, and resolute … for none of woman born shall harm Macbeth.

quote.text: 沒有一個婦人所生的人能傷害馬克白
quote.en: None of woman born shall harm Macbeth.

panels.prompt: a cloaked king laughing darkly in green firelight, half relief half madness on his scarred face

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 那就活下去吧，麥克德夫——我何必怕你？
dialogue.en: Then live, Macduff: what need I fear of thee?

panels.prompt: a child apparition wearing a golden crown and holding a leafy tree branch, rising in a column of pale smoke above the cauldron, solemn glowing eyes

dialogue.speaker: 第三幽靈
dialogue.text: 除非勃南森林向鄧西嫩高山移動，馬克白永遠不會被人打敗。
dialogue.en: Macbeth shall never vanquished be until Great Birnam Wood to high Dunsinane Hill shall come against him.

panels.prompt: a scarred king spreading his arms wide in the firelit cave, head thrown back in triumphant laughter, shadows dancing huge on the cave walls

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 誰能命令樹木，叫它拔起自己的根？好預兆！
dialogue.en: That will never be: who can impress the forest, bid the tree unfix his earth-bound root?

panels.prompt: a spectral procession of eight crowned kings walking through cave mist, the last holding up a mirror reflecting an endless line of crowns, and behind them the blood-matted ghost of a braided-bearded warrior smiling and pointing at the procession

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 第八個還拿著鏡子，照出數不盡的王冠——血汙的班柯在微笑，指著他們：那都是他的子孫！
dialogue.en: And yet the eighth appears, who bears a glass which shows me many more … blood-boltered Banquo smiles upon me, and points at them for his.

panels.prompt: the cave suddenly empty and cold, a dead fire pit, thin grey daylight leaking from the cave mouth

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 願這不祥的時辰，在日曆上永遠被人咒詛！
dialogue.en: Let this pernicious hour stand aye accursed in the calendar!

panels.prompt: seen from deep inside the dark cave, a tiny nobleman silhouetted in the jagged bright cave mouth far away, bowing, sheets of rain falling in the daylight behind him

dialogue.speaker: 列諾克斯
dialogue.text: 啟稟陛下——麥克德夫已經逃奔英格蘭去了！

panels.prompt: Macbeth, a broad-shouldered warrior in dark plate armor, shoulder-length black hair, short black beard, a pale diagonal scar across his left cheek, mounting a black warhorse against a storm sky, cloak spread like black wings, a distant castle on the horizon

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白（內心）
dialogue.text: 從這一刻起——想到，便下手。突襲費輔，把麥克德夫的妻子兒女，一齊殺死。
dialogue.en: From this moment the very firstlings of my heart shall be the firstlings of my hand. The castle of Macduff I will surprise … give to the edge o' the sword his wife, his babes.
